patch_description: This replaces repeated single-point random walks in a square with a population-based differential-evolution search inside a fixed triangular convex hull. The three hull vertices are fixed, all other points are projected into the triangle, and the hull area is constant, making normalization exact and stable. Differential evolution performs global recombination across whole configurations rather than becoming trapped in coordinate-wise lattice basins. A deterministic active-constraint coordinate polish then improves the exact smallest triangle area using dense directional candidates and lower-tail tie-breaking.
